verdict.rationale: Lindy's routines docs describe hands-off automation: you set a schedule or trigger once and Lindy runs the whole job on autopilot. Background behaviors such as overnight inbox triage, morning briefs, waiting drafts and scheduled daily briefs corroborate this, and guardrails control what it does without asking. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that routines run reliably unattended.
